### microChannel2d

This is a two-dimensional example of a channel with predefined pressures and temperatures at both ends where a rarefied gas flow is developing according to the chosen Knudsen number and considering the Knudsen slip and thermal creep effects

$$
u_s = \frac{2-\sigma_\nu}{\sigma_\nu} \left[ \frac{\lambda}{1+b Kn} \right] \Bigl( \frac{\partial u_t}{\partial n} \Bigr)_w + u_{tc},
$$

where $u_s$ is the resulting slip velocity, $\sigma_\nu$ is the accommodation coefficient, $\lambda$ the mean free path of the gas particle under the given conditions, and $\Bigl( \frac{\partial u_t}{\partial n} \Bigr)_w$ is the derivative of the tangential velocity in the wall normal direction.
In *OpenLB*, this boundary condition is realized by combining the Bouzidi bounce back with slip velocity, which is computed using the second-order finite differences for tangential velocities that are interpolated at the points where the wall normal is pointing.
The boundary condition is set as

```{.cpp}
setBouzidiBoundary<T,DESCRIPTOR,KnudsenVelocityPostProcessor<true>>(sLattice, superGeometry.getMaterialIndicator({2}), superGeometry.getMaterialIndicator({1,3,4}), channel);
setBouzidiKnudsenSlipVelocity<T,DESCRIPTOR,true>(sLattice, superGeometry.getMaterialIndicator({2}), superGeometry.getMaterialIndicator({1,3,4}), channel);
```

The analytical velocity distribution in the channel height can be formulated as

$$
u(y) = \frac{h^2}{2\mu} \frac{dP}{dx} \left[ \frac{y^2}{h^2} - \frac{y}{h} - \frac{2 - \sigma_v}{\sigma_v} \cdot \frac{\mathrm{Kn}}{1 + \mathrm{Kn}} \right] + \frac{3\mu R}{4P} \left( \frac{\partial T}{\partial s} \right)_w.
$$

The example leads to a convergence order of 2.03 by $Kn=0.45$ and a relaxation time of 1.13.
